description: Who holds assets and keys, how users withdraw, what happens on suspension or shutdown, who is responsible for third-party infrastructure, and whether defined terms are used consistently.
watch_for: Declared custody model versus mechanics (pooled or operational wallets, keys held by the operator, operator-initiated transfers). Withdrawal promises versus delays and suspension. Consequences for user assets after termination.

description: Liability limits, warranty disclaimers, indemnity, risk disclosure, yield statements, regulatory status of the operator.
watch_for: Absolute disclaimers versus duties the operator actually assumes. Limits that are blank or cancelled by carve-outs. Product wording that sounds like investment services versus a no-advice disclaimer.

description: Sanctions and geographic limits, AML/KYC, taxes, personal data, consumer rights, and references to documents that are not provided.
watch_for: Declared restrictions versus real measures. Policies referenced but not attached. Missing privacy terms.

description: Operator identity, how the contract is accepted, eligibility, fees, amendments, governing law, dispute resolution, intellectual property, general provisions.
watch_for: Placeholders instead of operator details, vague acceptance, unilateral changes without notice, a chosen law without a forum, optional wording such as 'may seek relief'.
